# Final Radiance Implementation Plan

The Awtsmoos is beyond ownership and adornment; Awtsmoos.com will make one optional finite Radiance unlock truthful, permanent, account-bound, and incapable of double charging.

## Server Truth
- Generate one Radiance paid action for every canonical product discovered by the existing product graph.
- Cost is server-owned and browser code may only name the action.
- A production Radiance handler is deterministic, bounded, and contains no external provider dependency.
- Credit packs become live because every product now has at least one real handler-backed paid capability.

## Exactly-Once Ownership
- Existing execution replay remains highest-priority idempotency testimony.
- Fresh action keys check durable entitlement ownership before creating a reservation.
- Successful settlement re-checks ownership inside the final Wallet transaction.
- If a concurrent execution already granted ownership, the second reservation is released instead of consumed.
- Otherwise commit and entitlement grant happen in one transaction before persistence.

## Files
- New `paidActionRadianceCatalog.js` for generated universal action definitions.
- New `paidActionPlannedCatalog.js` and `paidActionTestCatalog.js` to keep the main catalog small and readable.
- Whole rewrite `paidActionCatalog.js` as the authority aggregator.
- New `radiancePaidActionHandler.js` and whole rewrite `paidActionHandlerRegistry.js`.
- New `paidActionEntitlement.js`, `paidActionSuccessSettlement.js`, and `paidActionFailureSettlement.js`.
- Whole rewrite `paidActionExecutionStart.js` and `paidActionExecutionFinish.js` to compose ownership safely.
- New focused Radiance tests for 80-product coverage, server authority, fresh-key dedupe, concurrent ownership, and credit-pack availability.

## Immediate Follow-On
After server tests pass, expose Radiance through shared commerce UI, apply owned presentation through the global foundation with reduced-motion/high-contrast fallbacks, then move directly to crawler-visible Apps/Games inventory and generated SEO metadata.
